fails_if: `_coding_members` again lets `[[coding.choice]] keep_members` carry a blank code, so a choice can select and publish the empty string as a code
note: Maintainer decision (2026-10-08): a blank code is never a code. The replaced test kept `["", "Not applicable"]` as a documented blank sentinel; that handling is deleted and the selector is refused instead, like `coding-extend-blank-member-code-refused`. The allowed twin is register `keepmembers` of the build case coding-entries-apply-or-go-stale-per-register; register `blankcode` there shows a source list with a blank code withheld as unknown membership.

message_contains: member codes and labels must be nonempty
